port.description: The port on which the SSH daemon listens for incoming connections.

listen_address.description: The IP address the SSH daemon binds to. Use '' or '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

protocol_version.description: SSH protocol version to use. Only version 2 is secure and supported.

password_auth_enabled.description: Enable password-based authentication. Recommended false in favor of public keys.

authorized_keys_file.description: Path to the file containing user public keys (relative to user's home directory).

login_grace_time.description: Time (in seconds) the server waits for client to complete authentication before disconnecting.

permit_root_login.description: Whether root login is allowed. Options: 'no', 'yes', 'without-password', 'forceroot'.

max_auth_tries.description: Maximum number of authentication attempts per connection.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of open sessions per network connection.

allow_users.description: List of usernames allowed to log in. If non-empty, only these users may log in.

allow_groups.description: List of group names whose members are allowed to log in. If non-empty, only members of these groups may log in.

host_key_algorithms.description: Ordered list of accepted host key algorithms (for server identification).

kex_algorithms.description: Ordered list of key exchange algorithms to support.

ciphers.description: Ordered list of encryption ciphers to support (cipher modes only).

macs.description: Ordered list of message authentication code (MAC) algorithms to support.

log_level.description: Verbosity level of logs. Use values like 10 (ERROR), 20 (WARN), 30 (INFO), 40 (DEBUG).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility for SSH logs. Options: DAEMON, USER, AUTH, LOCAL0–LOCAL7.

x11_forwarding_enabled.description: Enable X11 forwarding for GUI applications over SSH.

x11_display_offset.description: First X11 display number to use for forwarded connections.

sftp_subsystems.description: Define one or more SFTP subsystems with name and executable path.

executable.description: Path to the SFTP subsystem binary

match_blocks.description: List of Match blocks for conditional configuration. Each block has criteria (e.g., 'User admin') and directives.

reason.description: Optional human-readable comment describing the match block purpose

directives.description: List of directives to apply when the match criteria is satisfied.

value.description: Directive value (as string; do not quote unless required)

client_alive_count_max.description: Number of missed keep-alive messages before server disconnects client.

tcp_keep_alive.description: Send TCP keep-alive packets (use false with connection managers like SSH Multiplexing).

banner.description: Path to banner file to display before authentication (e.g., /etc/issue.net). Leave empty to disable.

strict_modes.description: Require strict permissions on user files and directories (recommended true for security).

ignore_rhosts.description: Ignore .rhosts and .shosts files (recommended true for security).

use_pam.description: Enable PAM for authentication (required for many advanced features like account/session modules).
